from.name: BSD routed single/dominant RIP-family daemon role

property: replacement/role expansion from routed-centric interior routing to one configurable daemon speaking RIP, EGP and HELLO across routing domains

sources.supports: Contemporary text calls GateD a replacement for routed and describes RIP/EGP/HELLO interoperation.

negative_claims: This does not claim all routed code was inherited by GateD.
It does not make GateD the ancestor of every later multiprotocol routing suite.
open_questions: Acquire first GateD source and compare its kernel/RIP code with routed.
notes: Strong role-successor evidence with code ancestry still open.
